papers.title: CHARM: A Multimodal Graph Foundation Model with Hierarchical Context Modeling for Zero-Shot Transfer
papers.abstract: Graph foundation models (GFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for transferring knowledge across graph domains and tasks. Real-world graphs associate nodes with text, images, and other modalities, making multimodal graphs essential for representing complex entities and relations. Moreover, collecting labels and adapting models for every new graph domain is costly and often infeasible, motivating zero-shot transfer. Unfortunately, zero-shot transfer on multimodal graphs remains underexplored. Existing GNN-based graph foundation models typically require downstream adaptation, whereas LLM-based graph methods mainly address unimodal graphs or tasks within a single domain. This setting presents two key challenges. First, models must generalize knowledge from individual modalities while capturing transferable cross-modal relations. Second, without target-domain fine-tuning, node representations remain entangled with domain-specific structures and modality-specific characteristics, obscuring shared concepts in unseen domains. To address these challenges, we propose CHARM, a multimodal graph foundation model with hierarchical context modeling for zero-shot transfer. CHARM replaces isolated raw nodes with hierarchical graph contexts that capture multimodal semantics and cross-modal relations. These contexts map domain-specific node patterns to shared high-level concepts, reducing reliance on target-domain supervision or adaptation. A modality-aware graph context encoder integrates multimodal information with graph structure and converts the resulting representations into graph tokens for a large language model . Experiments show consistent improvements on zero-shot multimodal graph tasks.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态图上的零样本迁移尚未被充分探索，现有方法要么需要下游适应，要么只能处理单模态图或单领域任务，难以解决节点表示与领域/模态特征纠缠的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出CHARM，一种多模态图基础模型，利用分层上下文建模将原始节点替换为包含多模态语义和跨模态关系的分层图上下文，并通过模态感知的图上下文编码器整合多模态信息与图结构，生成图token供大语言模型处理，实现零样本迁移。
ai_summary.result: 在零样本多模态图任务上，CHARM取得了持续一致的性能提升。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新性地提出分层图上下文建模，将领域/模态特定的节点模式映射到共享高层概念，结合大语言模型实现无需目标域微调的零样本迁移。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了多模态图基础模型的发展，为跨领域、跨模态的零样本图学习提供了新范式，融合了图神经网络与大语言模型的优势。

papers.title: INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models
papers.abstract: Forward latent world models predict how actions change a scene, but recover actions for a desired change only through expensive test-time search. We introduce INTACT (INtent-To-ACTion), an end-to-end JEPA that turns action-labeled, reward-free trajectories into a deployable intent-to-action interface. Each transition supplies physical intent $z_{t+1}-z_t$, while a future goal supplies deployment intent $\operatorname{sg}(z_g)-z_t$. The architecture is isomorphic between the local and goal motion-intent backbone-input graphs through an identical four-slot grammar and shared parameters, and between supported local and goal motion-intent families through action-law semantics induced by the same predictor rather than pointwise latent equality. INTACT also provides intact transfer from RGB evidence to action-effective latent intent coordinates and from intent families to their corresponding action-law families. Asymmetric endpoint gradients ground physical successors and fix future goals as anchors, joining representation learning and control without pointwise latent matching or globally linear dynamics. The resulting coordinates support a robust distributional action law: its conditional mean serves directly as a search-free policy, while sampling remains available for diversity or optional verification. On the four official LeWM tasks, one-epoch, zero-search models reach 85.78\%, 100.00\%, 97.67\%, and 97.89\% success. Optional local CEM centered on the Direct plan reaches 96.86\% macro success using 384 instead of 9,000 candidate sequences, reducing sampling by $23.44\times$ while improving pure CEM by 16.00 points. One shared four-task encoder reaches 89.39\% E5 Direct macro and improves every task over jointly trained LeWM, while predicted--expert action-family kNN tracks Direct success at $r=0.954$. Direct inference takes 2.9--5.5 ms.

ai_summary.problem: 前向潜在世界模型通过测试时搜索来恢复动作，但计算成本高，需要一种无需搜索即可从意图直接映射到动作的方法。
ai_summary.method: 提出INTACT，一种端到端联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），通过同构的局部和目标运动意图图、共享参数和动作法则语义，学习从RGB证据到动作有效潜在意图坐标的映射，并使用非对称端点梯度联合表示学习与控制，无需逐点潜在匹配或全局线性动力学。
ai_summary.result: 在四个LeWM任务上，单轮零搜索模型达到85.78%-100%成功率；结合可选局部CEM，采样减少23.44倍且性能提升16个百分点；直接推理仅需2.9-5.5毫秒。
ai_summary.novelty: 同构的意图到动作学习架构，通过相同的四槽语法和共享参数实现局部和全局运动意图图之间的结构同构，并通过预测器诱导的动作法则语义实现动作族之间的同构，无需搜索即可直接获得策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型提供了一种高效的无搜索控制方案，推动具身智能和机器人学习中实时规划与决策的实用性。

papers.title: $π\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist manipulation policies increasingly take the form of action-chunking flow policies built on large pretrained backbones. Such chunks run open-loop, so the policy cannot react to sensory input arriving mid-execution, sacrificing \emph{reactivity}. Replanning more often would restore it, but the perception-to-action pipeline (a large backbone plus multiple denoising steps) is too slow: this \emph{latency} forbids frequent replanning and leaves committed actions stale, making such policies ill-suited for dynamic, closed-loop control. We present $π\mathbf{R}^2$, which makes these policies reactive and real-time while retaining large backbones, expressive multi-modal policies, and multi-action prediction. Built on the per-position noise schedule of diffusion forcing, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ contributes two ideas. First, it splits conditioning into a fast channel (proprioception, fresh every tick) and an asynchronously updated slow channel (vision-language features), so the policy reacts to proprioception within a chunk while tolerating stale vision. Second, a latency-adaptive flow schedule treats in-flight actions as inpainting conditioning and emits actions in one denoising step per call, letting one trained model adapt to varying hardware latency. Requiring minimal modification to existing architectures, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ can be finetuned from a pretrained policy: applied to GR00T-N1.7 on a real xArm6+XHand platform, it replans closed-loop roughly $4\times$ faster than the base policy (~$25$Hz on an A5000 GPU), acting on a fresh observation every $40$ms. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ improves the success rate by up to $23\%$ in simulation and $30\%$ in the real world over the strongest baseline. Project page: https://pi-r2-flow.github.io/

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决通用操作策略中基于预训练大模型的动作块策略反应性差和延迟高的问题，使其能够进行实时闭环控制。
ai_summary.method: 提出πR²，基于扩散强制的位置噪声调度，通过将条件输入分为快速通道（本体感知，每帧更新）和慢速通道（视觉语言特征，异步更新），并采用延迟自适应流调度，将进行中的动作视为修复条件，每次调用一步去噪生成动作，从而在保持大模型和多模态策略的同时实现高反应性和低延迟。
ai_summary.result: 在真实xArm6+XHand平台上，πR²实现了约25Hz的闭环重规划（比基础策略快约4倍），在仿真和真实任务中成功率比最强基线分别提高23%和30%。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出将条件输入分为快慢双通道并采用延迟自适应流调度，使预训练的动作块流策略能够实时反应并适应不同硬件延迟。
ai_summary.relevance: 该方法使通用操作策略兼具大模型的能力和实时闭环控制的反应性，推动具身智能中动态操作任务的实用化。
ai_summary.org: 未知

papers.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
papers.abstract: We present Wonder, a general-purpose video world model for real-time, camera-controllable world exploration. Given an image or a conditional video, Wonder constructs a playable world where users can navigate interactively by moving the camera, discovering unseen regions, and revisiting previously observed areas in real time and over a long-term horizon. Achieving this capability requires a system-level co-design of control method, memory mechanism, and training strategy. We introduce a novel camera conditioning with a dense coordinate field whose renderings provide spatially aligned motion and orientation cues, allowing the model to interpret camera motion directly as visual evidence. To support fast and precise memory retrieval over a growing generation context, we propose an efficient sparse attention-based memory mechanism, enabling the model to selectively attend to a small set of relevant context tokens at inference time, regardless of actual context length. We further develop several techniques to rectify the self-forcing-style distillation pipeline, improving the student model's ability to respect control signals, as well as maintaining diverse generation modes and long-term memory from the teacher. Together, these components enable Wonder to synthesize diverse, minute-scale videos at 16 FPS while preserving coherent geometry, appearance, and dynamics across long rollouts. Beyond image-to-video generation, Wonder naturally supports video-conditioned generation, allowing existing dynamic scenes to be re-shot in real time.

ai_summary.problem: 构建一个支持实时、长期、交互式摄像头控制的通用视频世界模型，以解决现有模型在导航、记忆和一致性方面的不足。
ai_summary.method: 提出系统级协同设计：采用密集坐标场渲染提供空间对齐的运动和方向线索实现相机控制；设计稀疏注意力机制实现高效长上下文记忆检索；改进自蒸馏训练流程，强化学生模型对控制信号的遵循并保持教师模型的多样化生成与长期记忆。
ai_summary.result: Wonder能以16 FPS生成分钟级、几何外观动态连贯的视频，并支持视频条件生成实现实时重拍现有动态场景。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地将密集坐标场相机条件化、稀疏注意力记忆机制与改进的自蒸馏训练相结合，实现实时、可导航的长视频世界模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频世界模型在交互式探索、长期一致性方面设立新标杆，对具身智能、仿真和内容创作领域具有重要推动作用。
ai_summary.org: Adobe Research与约翰霍普金斯大学

papers.title: Beyond Zooming: Learning Multi-Tool Visual Reasoning for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
papers.abstract: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote-sensing (RS) imagery provides fine-grained Earth-observation evidence over city-scale scenes, but poses a fundamental challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs): task-relevant evidence is often sparse, local, and spatially dispersed across extremely large visual contexts. A natural solution is to equip MLLMs with zoom-in tools for active local inspection. However, through a pilot study on XLRS-Bench, we find that zoom-in is only partially effective: it resolves easy and medium-level tasks with locally recoverable evidence, but saturates on hard cases requiring global search, multi-region comparison, path planning, or dispersed-evidence reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we move beyond single-tool zoom-in and introduce GeoMTVR, a large-scale Geospatial Multi-Tool Visual Reasoning dataset built from wide-area satellite imagery. GeoMTVR contains 13K UHR VQA samples with interleaved reasoning trajectories, diverse visual tool calls, and returned visual observations, enabling models to learn question decomposition, tool selection, regional inspection, object-level grounding, auxiliary visual reasoning, and cross-tool evidence integration. Beyond supervised fine-tuning, we propose a tool-attention-focused reinforcement learning algorithm that concentrates optimization on critical tool-use decisions, including when to invoke tools, which tool to select, where to apply it, and how to interpret tool outputs. By combining SFT on GeoMTVR with our RL algorithm, we develop GeoLens, a multi-tool visual reasoning MLLM for UHR RS. Experiments show that GeoLens consistently outperforms direct reasoning and single-tool zoom-in baselines, achieving stronger accuracy, better evidence grounding, and more efficient tool-use trajectories.

ai_summary.problem: 超高分辨率遥感图像中，多模态大语言模型难以处理稀疏、局部且空间分散的视觉证据。
ai_summary.method: 提出GeoMTVR数据集，包含多工具视觉推理轨迹和观察结果；并开发GeoLens模型，结合监督微调和工具注意力强化学习，实现问题分解、工具选择和跨工具证据整合。
ai_summary.result: GeoLens在准确率、证据定位和工具使用效率上一致优于直接推理和单工具缩放基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出面向超高分辨率遥感的多工具视觉推理框架，并设计针对工具使用决策的强化学习算法。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动多模态大语言模型在复杂、高分辨率视觉任务（如遥感、医学影像）中具备主动推理和工具调用能力。

papers.title: MODUS: Decoder-Only Any-to-Any Modeling of Diverse Modalities
papers.abstract: Any-to-any models predict any modality from any combination of others within a single network, a formulation used in multimodal vision and vision-language models, and increasingly in scientific domains such as ecology and astronomy. Existing any-to-any models are typically trained from scratch using encoder-decoder or diffusion architectures, impacting their performance and preventing them from using strong pre-trained decoder-only models as a prior. In this work, we investigate decoder-only any-to-any multimodal modeling, which treats all modalities symmetrically and supports arbitrary modalities as inputs and outputs without modality-specific heads, losses, or task pipelines. Because every modality is both an input and an output of the same model, the resulting model, named Modus, can support a range of applications, such as chained generation through intermediate modalities or cross-modal self-verification by scoring the model's own outputs with another generated modality. Modus demonstrates strong out-of-the-box performance and is competitive with specialist and multitask baselines using a single model across various benchmarks. All materials are open-sourced at https://modus-multimodal.epfl.ch/.

ai_summary.problem: 现有任意模态到任意模态的模型通常使用编码器-解码器或扩散架构从头训练，性能受限且无法利用强大的预训练仅解码器模型。
ai_summary.method: 提出MODUS，一种纯解码器架构，对称地处理所有模态，无需模态特定的输出头、损失函数或任务流水线，直接将所有模态作为输入和输出。
ai_summary.result: MODUS在多个基准测试中表现出强大的开箱即用性能，与专业模型和多任务基线竞争，并支持链式生成和跨模态自验证等应用。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将仅解码器架构成功应用于任意模态到任意模态的多模态建模，实现了模态对称性和任务通用性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型提供了一种更简洁、可扩展的框架，有望推动视觉、语言和科学领域（如生态学、天文学）的统一建模。
ai_summary.org: EPFL（瑞士联邦理工学院洛桑分校）

papers.title: A Cost-Effective Multimodal LLM Reasoning Framework for Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series
papers.abstract: Question answering (QA) over irregular clinical time series (ICTS) plays a pivotal role in a wide range of healthcare applications. Although recent multimodal time-series large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in general-purpose time-series QA, they remain poorly equipped to model the sparsity, asynchrony, and irregular sampling patterns of clinical observations. To fill this gap, we propose ClinPRISM, a cost-effective multimodal LLM reasoning framework for question answering over ICTS data. First, we devise an irregularity-aware multi-scale encoder to capture sparse clinical evidence at diverse temporal scales. Then, we propose a temporal evidence distiller to integrate representations across these scales and compress them into a small number of LLM-compatible tokens. Moreover, we introduce a progressive alignment strategy that sequentially aligns the irregular trajectories with the LLM's textual embedding space. To facilitate training, we construct 30,000 clinical time series paired with multi-scale descriptions, together with 41,000 instruction-tuning instances spanning 11 tasks. Using a 4-billion-parameter LLM backbone, ClinPRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the held-out evaluation benchmark while using only 16 time-series tokens and achieving an average inference latency of 0.15 seconds per question.

ai_summary.problem: 解决不规则临床时间序列（ICTS）上的问答任务，现有多模态时间序列大模型难以处理临床观测的稀疏性、异步性和不规则采样模式。
ai_summary.method: 提出ClinPRISM框架，包含不规则感知多尺度编码器、时间证据蒸馏器将多尺度表示压缩为少量LLM兼容token，以及渐进对齐策略将不规则轨迹与LLM文本嵌入空间对齐，并构建了30k多尺度描述对和41k指令微调实例。
ai_summary.result: 基于4B参数LLM，仅用16个时间序列token和0.15秒平均推理延迟，在保留测试集上达到SOTA性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 针对不规则时序数据设计了多尺度编码、证据蒸馏和渐进对齐的端到端方法，有效压缩临床证据并适配LLM。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态LLM在医疗时间序列分析领域的高效推理提供了低成本、高准确度的新范式，推动了AI在临床问答中的应用。
ai_summary.org: 未明确

papers.title: SAM3D-Guided Object-Centric Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general robot manipulation, but most existing models rely on 2D visual-language backbones and lack fine-grained 3D understanding of target objects, especially under occlusion, pose variation, scale changes, and precise spatial interaction. We propose an object-centric 3D representation alignment framework built upon $π_0$, using SAM3D as a frozen 3D teacher to provide target-object 3D priors during training. Specifically, we localize task-relevant objects with object recognition models, generate corresponding object masks, and use SAM3D to extract dense object-level 3D representations, which are aligned with intermediate visual features of $π_0$. This enables the policy to internalize target-object 3D information while preserving the original RGB-language-to-action inference pipeline without requiring depth, point clouds, masks, SAM3D, or additional 3D modules at test time. Simulation experiments show consistent improvements, achieving 99.1\% on LIBERO and an average length of 4.11 on CALVIN. Real-world experiments further demonstrate that our method is particularly effective in long-horizon manipulation scenarios where the robot must focus on different target objects across multiple subtasks.

ai_summary.problem: 现有Vision-Language-Action (VLA)模型大多依赖2D视觉语言骨干，缺乏对目标物体的细粒度3D理解，尤其在遮挡、姿态变化、尺度变化和精确空间交互场景下表现不佳。
ai_summary.method: 提出基于π0的物体中心3D表示对齐框架，利用SAM3D作为冻结的3D教师模型，在训练时为目标物体提供3D先验；通过目标识别定位物体并生成掩码，提取密集的物体级3D表示，与π0的中间视觉特征进行对齐，使策略内化目标物体3D信息，同时在测试时无需深度、点云、掩码、SAM3D或额外3D模块。
ai_summary.result: 模拟实验在LIBERO上达到99.1%成功率，在CALVIN上平均任务长度4.11；真实世界实验中，该方法在需要跨子任务聚焦不同目标物体的长时域操作场景中表现尤为有效。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新性地将SAM3D的3D知识通过表示对齐方式蒸馏到VLA模型的2D视觉特征中，在不改变测试时推理流程的前提下提升了模型的3D理解能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为视觉-语言-动作模型赋予了目标物体的3D空间理解能力，推动了机器人操作在复杂场景下的泛化性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
papers.abstract: Learning deployable manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of data that is both high-fidelity and scalable. Real-robot teleoperation is accurate but costly to scale; robot-free UMI capture scales readily, and current practice uses the resulting data mainly for pre-training, adding a small real-robot "anchor" at post-training. We ask whether raising the fidelity of robot-free UMI data, rather than shrinking the real-robot fraction, can remove that anchor. We present HiFi-UMI, a portable UMI data-production system co-designed for trajectory accuracy, inter-gripper relative pose, synchronization, and field of view: head-mounted offline stereo-inertial SLAM, native rather than reconstructed relative pose, a shared microsecond GPIO trigger, and two wide-angle cameras per hand covering ~200 degrees. It reaches 3 mm workspace-local end-effector accuracy without external tracking infrastructure. Using this corpus, we demonstrate zero-robot post-training: a policy post-trained solely on HiFi-UMI demonstrations deploys directly on a real robot and matches in-domain teleoperation across three backbones spanning the vision-language-action and world-action-model families, with success-rate differences of -2.5, +3.1, and -0.6 percentage points on StarVLA-QwenPI, OpenPI-pi_0.5, and LingBot-VA; the strongest policy reaches 85% on a precision insertion task, even though the teleoperation baseline is collected in the evaluation scene and no HiFi-UMI trajectory is. Pre-training on 4,000 hours from the same corpus lowers action error on ten unseen tasks by 41% and, on StarVLA-QwenPI, raises real-robot success by a further 18.1 percentage points. We open-source HiFi-UMI-2K, 2,000 hours of microsecond-synchronized, ultra-wide-FoV demonstrations, each automatically reconstructed and validated through simulation replay, as a large-scale, high-fidelity resource for the robot-learning community.

ai_summary.problem: 现有机器人操作策略的学习依赖于真实机器人遥操作数据（精确但成本高）或机器人自由的UMI数据（可扩展但保真度低，仍需少量真实机器人数据微调），如何通过提高UMI数据保真度来完全消除对真实机器人后训练数据的需求。
ai_summary.method: 提出HiFi-UMI便携式数据采集系统，通过头戴式离线立体惯性SLAM、原生相对位姿、共享微秒级GPIO触发及每手两个广角相机（覆盖约200度）等协同设计，实现3mm工作空间局部末端执行器精度的高保真轨迹数据采集；基于此语料库，仅使用HiFi-UMI数据进行策略后训练（零机器人后训练），并利用大规模预训练提升泛化性。
ai_summary.result: 零机器人后训练的策略在真实机器人上部署成功，与使用真实机器人遥操作后训练的策略性能相当（成功率差异-2.5至+3.1个百分点），最佳策略在精密插入任务达85%成功率；预训练4,000小时数据降低10个未见任务动作误差41%，并进一步提升18.1个百分点真实机器人成功率，开源2,000小时数据资源。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次通过协同设计高保真UMI数据采集系统，实现无需任何真实机器人数据即可直接部署的操作策略，挑战了“必须用少量真实机器人数据微调”的常见范式。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人学习社区提供低成本、可扩展的高保真数据生产方案，有望大规模推动部署性操作学习，减少对昂贵遥操作数据的依赖。
ai_summary.org: Simple AI

papers.title: S2A2: Audio-Visual Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Using Acoustic Spatial Information
papers.abstract: Acoustic information provides rich cues about object location, material properties, and changes caused by contact or motion. This paper introduces a new set of acoustic-aware manipulation tasks for imitation learning, in which robots must use auditory cues to determine manipulation targets. These tasks require sound source localization and identification for active exploration in robotic manipulation. Also, we propose a multimodal imitation learning framework, Spatial-Spectral Audio Action (S2A2), that integrates visual features with acoustic spatial and acoustic signal information for the acoustic-aware manipulation tasks. We implemented S2A2 models that integrates policies such as ACT, Diffusion Policy, VQ-BeT, and $π_0$, into our framework. Simulation experiments showed that the proposed method is the most effective for tasks requiring both position and timbre. Furthermore, real-robot experiments confirm the applicability of the proposed tasks and framework to real-world manipulation.

ai_summary.problem: 如何让机器人利用听觉信息（如物体位置、材质和运动声音）来辅助模仿学习中的操作任务，特别是在视觉信息不足或复杂场景下。
ai_summary.method: 提出S2A2框架，一种多模态模仿学习框架，将视觉特征与声音的空间（如声源定位）和频谱信息结合，并集成了ACT、Diffusion Policy、VQ-BeT和π0等多种策略。
ai_summary.result: 仿真实验表明该方法在需要位置和音色信息的任务中效果最佳，真实机器人实验也验证了其在实际操作中的可行性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将声音的空间信息（声源定位和识别）系统性地融入模仿学习的操作任务中，扩展了机器人多模态感知的维度。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了机器人具身智能中多模态感知和模仿学习的发展，为更鲁棒的复杂操作任务提供了新思路。
ai_summary.org: 未知

papers.title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening
papers.abstract: We present VetClaw, an edge-cloud multimodal agentic system for early veterinary disease screening. VetClaw uses a camera module as an edge sensing device and sends captured images, together with optional symptom descriptions, to a server-hosted vision-language model for zero-shot disease classification. The system separates agent interaction from workflow orchestration: OpenClaw provides scheduling, tool access, user interaction, and notification services on the edge device, while LangGraph manages the stateful screening workflow, including input validation, image transmission, model invocation, safety checks, conditional routing, failure handling, and structured logging. This design moves beyond static image classification by enabling the system to collect visual evidence, invoke external models, apply deterministic safety rules, and generate diagnostic-support alerts. Results show that image-only VLM prediction remains limited, whereas symptom-guided and multimodal inputs improve zero-shot classification performance. Thus, VetClaw transforms a static prediction model into a coordinated, safety-aware system that can use tools, manage workflows, handle failures, and escalate uncertain cases.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决早期兽医疾病筛查中静态图像分类性能有限、缺乏协同工作流和安全感知能力的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出VetClaw边缘-云多模态代理系统，通过相机模块捕获图像并可选症状描述，由服务器端视觉语言模型进行零样本分类；系统分离代理交互与工作流编排，使用OpenClaw管理边缘设备服务，LangGraph管理有状态筛查工作流（包括输入验证、图像传输、模型调用、安全检查和故障处理）。
ai_summary.result: 仅图像预测性能有限，而症状引导和多模态输入显著提升零样本分类性能；系统将静态模型转化为可协调、安全感知的疾病筛查工具，能处理不确定性并生成诊断警报。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将边缘-云架构、多模态代理和状态化工作流管理结合应用于兽医疾病筛查，实现从静态预测到动态协作系统的转变。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了如何将视觉语言模型与边缘计算、代理工作流结合，推动AI在特定领域（如兽医）的安全、实际部署。
ai_summary.org: 未明确

papers.title: Reinformed Dreamer: An Asymmetric World Model Efficiently Trained through Latent Guidance
papers.abstract: Much like humans benefit from guidance while learning, reinforcement learning algorithms may benefit from additional supervision beyond rewards. Leveraging additional information during training to learn better representations and behaviors has been the focus of asymmetric reinforcement learning. This learning paradigm has proven effective under partial observability when additional state information is available, but also under full observability when more refined state information is available. Focusing on model-based reinforcement learning, we study the effect of asymmetric learning on observation representations and on privileged information representations. First, we identify a limitation in the privileged information representations learned by an asymmetric model-based algorithm known as the Informed Dreamer. Then, we propose a novel asymmetric representation learning objective using latent guidance, resulting in a new algorithm called the Reinformed Dreamer. Experiments across several benchmarks show a more consistent improvement over Dreamer than previous asymmetric approaches.

ai_summary.problem: 在基于模型的强化学习中，现有非对称算法（如Informed Dreamer）学习的特权信息表示存在局限性，导致性能提升不稳定。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种新的非对称表示学习目标，通过潜在引导（latent guidance）来优化观测表示和特权信息表示，形成名为Reinformed Dreamer的算法。
ai_summary.result: 多个基准实验表明，Reinformed Dreamer相对于Dreamer的改进比之前的非对称方法更加一致和稳定。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次在非对称世界模型训练中使用潜在引导来同时优化观测和特权信息表示，克服了Informed Dreamer的表示缺陷。
ai_summary.relevance: 为非对称强化学习提供了更高效的表示学习范式，有助于提升基于世界模型的智能体在部分/全观测环境中的表现。
ai_summary.org: 未知（作者机构信息为空）

papers.title: LaP-Forensics: Latent-Pixel Consistency Guided Multimodal Reasoning for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract: Recent generative models can produce images with few obvious visual artifacts, weakening detectors and explanations that rely only on surface appearance. We present LaP-Forensics, a multimodal framework that augments RGB semantics with reconstruction-based forensic evidence. A frozen Stable Diffusion DDIM inversion-reconstruction model provides a fixed reconstruction reference, and its residual map measures local compatibility with that reference. Independent projectors encode the RGB image and residual map before a structured Where-What-Why model predicts a textual analysis and an artifact mask.Supervised fine-tuning is followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), whose reward combines mask overlap with output-structure and evidence-reference terms. These text-side terms encourage the model to refer to the consistency map but do not constitute a verifier of free-form textual truth. A separate image-level head fuses RGB and DDIM-residual class features. Experiments show cross-generator detection on UniversalFakeDetect and competitive artifact localization on the official SynthScars benchmark. Controlled cue-construction, inversion-horizon, component, reward-term, and counterfactual analyses support the utility of the residual stream under the evaluated settings, while free-form textual faithfulness and reliability under post-processing remain open limitations.

ai_summary.problem: 现有深度伪造检测方法依赖表面视觉特征，而新一代生成模型产生的图像伪影极难察觉，导致检测和解释失效。
ai_summary.method: 提出LaP-Forensics多模态框架，通过冻结的Stable Diffusion DDIM反演-重建模型生成固定重建参考，并计算残差图作为局部一致性证据；随后使用结构化Where-What-Why模型联合预测文本分析和伪影掩码，并采用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行优化。
ai_summary.result: 在UniversalFakeDetect跨生成器检测和SynthScars伪影定位基准上取得竞争性表现；控制实验验证了残差流的有效性，但自由文本忠实度和后处理鲁棒性仍存在局限。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将冻结的DDIM重建残差作为多模态证据与RGB语义融合，并结合结构化推理进行深度伪造检测与定位。
ai_summary.relevance: 为深度伪造检测提供了结合重建一致性证据与多模态推理的新范式，有助于提升检测的可解释性和跨生成器泛化能力。
ai_summary.org: 未明确标注，作者可能来自中国高校或研究机构。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Reasoning over Interacting Streams for Video-Level Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition
papers.abstract: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) are conflicting affective states that precede the delay or abandonment of health behaviour change. Recognition of A/H at the video level is difficult, since the signal arises from disagreement across and within facial, vocal, linguistic, and bodily modalities, and manifests differently across individuals. The proposed PRISM-AH (Predictive Reasoning over Interacting Streams for Multimodal Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition), is a framework that treats A/H as a multimodal conflict that unfolds over time. Frozen vision, audio, and text encoders are aligned into short time windows and passed to a lightweight streaming model that scores cross-modal dissonance, predicts each next window to expose a hesitation surprise signal, discovers behaviour prototypes, and is conditioned on participant metadata. Dense window-level annotations supervise the model as an auxiliary objective, and the decision threshold is calibrated for macro F1. A knowledge-guided large language model then reasons over structured evidence using the expert cue taxonomy of the dataset, and its verdict is fused late only when validation performance improves. On the labelled public test partition of 525 videos, PRISM-AH attains a macro F1 of 0.6133, compared to the reported zero-shot baseline of 0.2827. The reasoning gain is validated to transfer from validation to the larger test partition.

ai_summary.problem: 视频层面的矛盾心理和犹豫不决（A/H）识别困难，因为信号来自多模态（面部、声音、语言、身体）之间的不一致，且个体间表现差异大。
ai_summary.method: 提出PRISM-AH框架，将A/H建模为随时间展开的多模态冲突，使用冻结的视觉、音频和文本编码器对齐短时间窗口，通过轻量级流模型评分跨模态不和谐、预测下一窗口以暴露犹豫惊喜信号、发现行为原型并引入元数据条件；同时利用知识引导的LLM基于专家线索分类法进行推理，并在验证性能提升时进行后期融合。
ai_summary.result: 在525个视频的公共测试集上，宏F1达到0.6133，显著高于零样本基线0.2827，且推理增益从验证集迁移到更大的测试集。
ai_summary.novelty: 将多模态冲突建模为流式时序交互，并结合知识引导的LLM推理来增强视频级情感识别。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频级情感识别中多模态不一致性问题提供了新的解决方案，对多模态学习、时序建模和情感AI领域有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 无法明确识别具体机构，作者名字可能来自印度机构。

papers.title: Evaluating Multi-Turn Multimodal Diagnostic Reasoning on Challenging Real-World Clinical Cases
papers.abstract: Clinical diagnostic evaluation should not only assess whether models can provide correct diagnoses, but also reflect the realities of clinical practice, including progressive disclosure of multimodal information, dynamic updating of diagnostic hypotheses, and continuous refinement of clinical reasoning. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically rely on single-turn or isolated tasks, making it difficult to fully capture the complexity of real-world clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we developed ClinMM-Bench, the largest multi-turn multimodal clinical diagnostic evaluation benchmark to date. ClinMM-Bench contains 1,089 challenging real-world clinical cases and 3,760 medical images across eight specialties. We systematically evaluated 15 representative MLLMs using a two-level evaluation framework that assessed both diagnostic accuracy and diagnostic reasoning quality. Results showed that proprietary models achieved the highest overall diagnostic accuracy, but the proportion of completely correct diagnoses remained limited across all models. In terms of diagnostic reasoning quality, current models can identify plausible diagnostic directions but still have considerable limitations in generating reliable diagnostic reasoning. Error analysis further identified five representative failure modes: information synthesis failure, knowledge mapping error, perception error, premature closure, and visual hallucination.

ai_summary.problem: 现有评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）在临床诊断中依赖单轮或孤立任务，无法真实反映临床实践中多轮信息逐步披露、假设动态更新和推理持续优化的复杂性。
ai_summary.method: 开发了ClinMM-Bench，包含1089个真实临床病例和3760张医学图像（覆盖8个专科），并采用两级评估框架（诊断准确性和诊断推理质量）系统评估15个代表性MLLMs。
ai_summary.result: 专有模型整体诊断准确率最高，但完全正确诊断比例有限；模型能识别合理诊断方向但推理可靠性有限，并识别出信息合成失败、知识映射错误、感知错误、过早关闭和视觉幻觉五种典型失败模式。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个大规模多轮多模态临床诊断评估基准，同时评估诊断准确性和推理质量。
ai_summary.relevance: 为MLLMs在真实临床诊断应用中的评估提供了更贴近实践的基准，揭示了当前模型在复杂推理任务中的关键局限。
ai_summary.org: 未明确

papers.title: Evaluating VLMs for Autonomous Agent-Driven Geometry Clipping Detection in Video Game QA
papers.abstract: In this work, we study the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for anomaly detection in an agent-driven game Quality Assurance (QA) pipeline focusing on geometry clipping. In this evaluation, a custom exploration agent navigates a game level to collect visual observations, while the automatic annotation pipeline provides frame-level clipping labels. This setup allows us to evaluate recent VLMs on a controlled anomaly detection task without manual annotation. We benchmark six recent VLMs (Gemini, GPT, Qwen, Gemma, Llama, and Ministral) under a zero-shot prompting setting and analyse their sensitivity to four prompt variants.   Our results show that while the VLMs can capture visual cues associated with geometry clipping, they all produce substantial false positives on visually ambiguous frames such as near-contact geometry and partial occlusions. Gemini-3.1-Flash achieves the best overall accuracy and is the most robust to prompt variation, while open-source models exhibit large precision--recall swings depending on the prompt design. These findings suggest that current VLMs are best suited as high-recall candidate filters within multi-stage QA pipelines rather than as standalone bug detectors.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决如何利用视觉语言模型（VLM）在游戏质量保证（QA）中自动检测几何剪切（geometry clipping）异常的问题，以减少人工标注成本。
ai_summary.method: 构建了一个自定义探索代理自动导航游戏关卡收集视觉观测，并通过自动标注管道生成帧级剪切标签。随后在零样本提示设置下对六个近期VLM（Gemini、GPT、Qwen、Gemma、Llama、Ministral）进行基准测试，分析其对四种提示变体的敏感性。
ai_summary.result: 所有VLM都能捕捉与几何剪切相关的视觉线索，但在视觉模糊帧（如近接触几何和部分遮挡）上产生大量误报。Gemini-3.1-Flash在整体准确性和对提示变化的鲁棒性上最佳，开源模型则因提示设计出现精确率-召回率的剧烈波动。当前VLM更适合作为多阶段QA管道中的高召回候选过滤器，而非独立缺陷检测器。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统评估了多种VLM在代理驱动的游戏QA管道中零样本检测几何剪贴异常的性能，并揭示了其对提示设计的敏感性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为将VLM应用于游戏测试自动化提供了实证评估和设计指导，推动了具身智能体在工业QA场景中的落地。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未明确标注，但可能来自游戏或AI研究公司/实验室。

papers.title: AnnoBench: A Benchmark for Visualization Annotation Generation
papers.abstract: Annotation is among the most demanding visualization tasks to automate, as it simultaneously requires correctly navigating visual, semantic, and stylistic constraints. Failure to meet any of these conditions severely undermines the utility of an annotation, rendering it challenging to read, inaccurate, or visually discordant. Despite a growing body of annotation tools and automations, no existing benchmark or evaluation framework tests whether these conditions are met because of their scope and annotation not being the focus of their studies. We introduce AnnoBench, a benchmark for visualization annotation that materializes the inherent challenges of this domain in a structured and testable manner. AnnoBench pairs visualizations from professional data journalism and visualization galleries with annotation tasks, spanning four representation formats, five chart description conditions, and two prompt specification levels. The benchmark is executed via VLM-as-a-judge, using models aligned with manual human assessment. We evaluate the benchmark via four one-factor-at-a-time experiments, exploring the effects of input representation, semantic context, and prompt specificity, and model selection on annotation quality. This work provides a foundation for advancing annotation automation, tooling, and visualization-generation pipelines.

ai_summary.problem: 目前缺乏一个系统性的基准来衡量可视化注释的质量，以同时满足视觉、语义和风格约束。
ai_summary.method: 提出了AnnoBench基准，包含来自专业数据新闻和可视化画廊的图表及注释任务，覆盖四种表示格式、五种图表描述条件和两种提示规格级别，并采用VLM作为评估器进行自动评估。
ai_summary.result: 通过四个单因素实验，评估了输入表示、语义上下文、提示规格和模型选择对注释质量的影响，验证了基准的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个专门针对可视化注释自动化的标准化基准，将注释挑战转化为可测试的结构化任务。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在数据可视化注释生成和评估中的应用提供了基础框架和评测工具，推动AI辅助可视化生成管线的发展。

papers.title: Shieldstral
papers.abstract: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under one training framework. We present the data construction recipe, covering curation and generation of approximately 54.1M samples and a fine-grained evaluation set to evaluate policy adaptability. Together, these enable a small adaptive model to match or outperform much larger models.

ai_summary.problem: 如何在模型较小的情况下，构建一个能够匹配甚至超越大模型的多模态安全分类器，并统一异构的安全数据集？
ai_summary.method: 将内容审核建模为二元问答任务，统一多种审核任务为是/否问题；通过数据构建策略（约5410万样本和细粒度评估集）整合异构安全数据集，训练一个3B参数的策略自适应多模态安全分类器。
ai_summary.result: Shieldstral在文本安全基准上匹配或超越近7倍大小的模型，并在多模态安全分类上达到新SOTA。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过简单的二元问答公式统一异构安全数据集，使小模型能通过策略自适应匹配大模型性能。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态安全分类提供了一种高效、可扩展的框架，降低对大规模模型和昂贵数据标注的依赖。
ai_summary.org: 未明确，可能的机构为 Meta 或相关研究机构（基于作者 Guillaume Lample 等）。

papers.title: Food Image Segmentation with LLM-Derived Ingredient Labels and Multimodal Fusion
papers.abstract: Food image segmentation plays a vital role in health-related applications such as nutrition tracking and personalized health monitoring. However, existing models often underperform on visually similar ingredients and rare food categories. To address this issue, we propose two plug-and-play multimodal modules that enhance the segmentation performance by leveraging ingredient labels inferred from food images using large language models (LLMs). The first module, called LIM-F (Language Injection Module for Features), is designed to pair with any image encoder that produces multi-layer outputs (e.g., Swin Transformer), while the second module, LIM-Q (Language Injection Module for Queries), targets Mask2Former-style Transformer-based decoders. Both modules enable training without the need for pre-aligning images with text by directly injecting semantic ingredient information into the visual analysis pipeline. On the FoodSeg103 benchmark, the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Specifically, integrating LIM-Q into the Mask2Former decoder with a Swin-L image encoder yields a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 55.0. LIM-F also demonstrates strong generalization and competitive performance, reaching an mIoU of 54.4 under the same model (Swin-L+Mask2Former). Furthermore, its applicability extends beyond Transformer-based decoders, as evidenced by an improvement from 47.7 to 49.8 mIoU when integrated into a CNN-based architecture. Notably, the improved segmentation accuracy is achieved with only a moderate (at most 3.8 GB) increase in the GPU memory consumption during training. Thus, the proposed approach offers a practical and scalable solution for fine-grained food understanding.

ai_summary.problem: 现有食物图像分割模型在视觉相似食材和罕见类别上表现不佳。
ai_summary.method: 提出两个即插即用的多模态模块：LIM-F（注入特征）和LIM-Q（注入查询），利用大语言模型从食物图像推断食材标签，无需预对齐图像和文本即可直接注入语义信息。
ai_summary.result: 在FoodSeg103基准上达到SOTA，Swin-L+Mask2Former集成LIM-Q取得55.0 mIoU，LIM-F在CNN架构下将mIoU从47.7提升至49.8，且训练时GPU内存增加最多仅3.8 GB。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次利用LLM推断的食材标签作为辅助信息，以即插即用方式增强任意图像编码器或Transformer解码器的食物分割性能。
ai_summary.relevance: 为细粒度食物理解提供了一种高效、可扩展的多模态融合方案，促进AI在健康和营养领域的应用。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未明确给出，可能为台湾高校或研究机构。

papers.title: SepPrune:A Separator-based Pruning Framework for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3, generate large numbers of vision tokens for high-resolution inputs, leading to substantial computational cost. Existing vision token pruning methods either depend on cross-modal attention and cannot prune before the prefill stage, or rely on diversity estimation with high computational overhead. We observe that attention scores from both vision and text tokens peak at modality separator tokens, suggesting that these separators bridge the two modalities. Based on this observation, we propose SepPrune, an efficient, training-free, plug-and-play pruning method that uses the separator token as a unified query to rank and select informative vision tokens. SepPrune reuses the LLM's built-in projection parameters and requires no architectural changes. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B show that SepPrune achieves state-of-the-art performance, retaining 96.3% of the original accuracy while removing 80.2% of vision tokens.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大语言模型处理高分辨率输入时产生大量视觉token导致计算开销巨大，现有视觉token剪枝方法存在依赖跨模态注意力无法在预填充前剪枝、或依赖高计算开销的多样性估计等问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出SepPrune，一种基于分隔符token的无需训练、即插即用的剪枝框架，利用模态分隔符token作为统一查询来排序和选择信息性视觉token，并复用LLM内置投影参数，无需架构修改。
ai_summary.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上实现最先进性能，移除80.2%视觉token的同时保留96.3%的原始精度。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次观察到注意力分数在模态分隔符token处达到峰值，并利用分隔符token作为统一查询进行跨模态token剪枝。
ai_summary.relevance: 为高效多模态大语言模型提供了一种简单、训练免费且即插即用的剪枝方案，显著降低计算成本。
ai_summary.org: 未知

key_lab_papers.title: Evaluating VLMs for Autonomous Agent-Driven Geometry Clipping Detection in Video Game QA
key_lab_papers.abstract: In this work, we study the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for anomaly detection in an agent-driven game Quality Assurance (QA) pipeline focusing on geometry clipping. In this evaluation, a custom exploration agent navigates a game level to collect visual observations, while the automatic annotation pipeline provides frame-level clipping labels. This setup allows us to evaluate recent VLMs on a controlled anomaly detection task without manual annotation. We benchmark six recent VLMs (Gemini, GPT, Qwen, Gemma, Llama, and Ministral) under a zero-shot prompting setting and analyse their sensitivity to four prompt variants.   Our results show that while the VLMs can capture visual cues associated with geometry clipping, they all produce substantial false positives on visually ambiguous frames such as near-contact geometry and partial occlusions. Gemini-3.1-Flash achieves the best overall accuracy and is the most robust to prompt variation, while open-source models exhibit large precision--recall swings depending on the prompt design. These findings suggest that current VLMs are best suited as high-recall candidate filters within multi-stage QA pipelines rather than as standalone bug detectors.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决如何利用视觉语言模型（VLM）在游戏质量保证（QA）中自动检测几何剪切（geometry clipping）异常的问题，以减少人工标注成本。
ai_summary.method: 构建了一个自定义探索代理自动导航游戏关卡收集视觉观测，并通过自动标注管道生成帧级剪切标签。随后在零样本提示设置下对六个近期VLM（Gemini、GPT、Qwen、Gemma、Llama、Ministral）进行基准测试，分析其对四种提示变体的敏感性。
ai_summary.result: 所有VLM都能捕捉与几何剪切相关的视觉线索，但在视觉模糊帧（如近接触几何和部分遮挡）上产生大量误报。Gemini-3.1-Flash在整体准确性和对提示变化的鲁棒性上最佳，开源模型则因提示设计出现精确率-召回率的剧烈波动。当前VLM更适合作为多阶段QA管道中的高召回候选过滤器，而非独立缺陷检测器。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统评估了多种VLM在代理驱动的游戏QA管道中零样本检测几何剪贴异常的性能，并揭示了其对提示设计的敏感性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为将VLM应用于游戏测试自动化提供了实证评估和设计指导，推动了具身智能体在工业QA场景中的落地。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未明确标注，但可能来自游戏或AI研究公司/实验室。

key_lab_papers.title: Shieldstral
key_lab_papers.abstract: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under one training framework. We present the data construction recipe, covering curation and generation of approximately 54.1M samples and a fine-grained evaluation set to evaluate policy adaptability. Together, these enable a small adaptive model to match or outperform much larger models.

ai_summary.problem: 如何在模型较小的情况下，构建一个能够匹配甚至超越大模型的多模态安全分类器，并统一异构的安全数据集？
ai_summary.method: 将内容审核建模为二元问答任务，统一多种审核任务为是/否问题；通过数据构建策略（约5410万样本和细粒度评估集）整合异构安全数据集，训练一个3B参数的策略自适应多模态安全分类器。
ai_summary.result: Shieldstral在文本安全基准上匹配或超越近7倍大小的模型，并在多模态安全分类上达到新SOTA。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过简单的二元问答公式统一异构安全数据集，使小模型能通过策略自适应匹配大模型性能。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态安全分类提供了一种高效、可扩展的框架，降低对大规模模型和昂贵数据标注的依赖。
ai_summary.org: 未明确，可能的机构为 Meta 或相关研究机构（基于作者 Guillaume Lample 等）。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日研究热点聚焦于多模态大模型，占论文总数的85%，涵盖遥感、医疗、机器人、视频理解等多个应用场景。世界模型方向也有显著进展，三篇论文提出了实时、可导航的视频世界模型及高效训练方法。大厂方面，Meta和Google合作评估VLM在游戏QA中零样本检测能力，Meta还发布了统一安全数据集的小模型对齐方法。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: Meta与Google在Agent驱动的VLM评估论文（Evaluating VLMs for Autonomous Agent-Driven Geometry Clipping Detection in Video Game QA）上有方向重合，均关注视频游戏中的几何剪贴异常检测，方法类似（系统性评估多种VLM零样本性能及提示敏感性），形成竞争性研究。Meta另有独立论文Shieldstral，涉及模型安全对齐，与Google无直接重合。
daily_insight.signals: 多模态论文异常集中，且开始出现从静态预测向动态协作系统转变的迹象（如VetClaw边缘-云医疗代理系统），世界模型论文数量回升（3篇），技术路线从单一模态向任意模态对称建模扩展（MODUS）。此外，无需真实机器人数据的操作策略（HiFi-UMI）挑战了领域常见范式。
